parameters.name: hostname
parameters.explanation: 设备的主机名，用于标识网络中的设备。

set interfaces ge-0/0/0 unit 0 family in.template: set interfaces [parameter1] unit [parameter2] family inet address [parameter3]/[parameter4]
set interfaces ge-0/0/0 unit 0 family in.command: set interfaces ge-0/0/0 unit 0 family inet address 10.2.1.1/30
set interfaces ge-0/0/0 unit 0 family in.explanation: 配置接口的IPv4地址及子网掩码。

parameters.name: unit
parameters.explanation: 接口单元号，用于区分同一接口下的多个逻辑配置。

set interfaces lo0 unit 0 family inet ad.template: set interfaces [parameter1] unit [parameter2] family inet address [parameter3]/[parameter4]
set interfaces lo0 unit 0 family inet ad.command: set interfaces lo0 unit 0 family inet address 4.4.4.4/32
set interfaces lo0 unit 0 family inet ad.explanation: 配置环回接口的IPv4地址及子网掩码。

parameters.name: unit
parameters.explanation: 接口单元号，用于区分同一接口下的多个逻辑配置。

delete routing-options autonomous-system.explanation: 删除路由选项中禁用自治系统的配置。

set protocols bgp group outside type ext.template: set protocols bgp group [parameter1] type [parameter2] peer-as [parameter3]
set protocols bgp group outside type ext.command: set protocols bgp group outside type external peer-as 100
set protocols bgp group outside type ext.explanation: 配置BGP协议的外部组类型及对等自治系统号。

set protocols bgp group outside neighbor.command: set protocols bgp group outside neighbor-address 10.2.1.2
set protocols bgp group outside neighbor.explanation: 配置BGP协议的外部组的邻居地址。

set protocols static route 0.0.0.0/0 nex.explanation: 配置静态路由的下一跳地址。

parameters.name: route
parameters.explanation: 静态路由的目的网络地址。

commit.explanation: 提交配置更改，使配置生效。
